result.title: Towards Multi-Value Alignment via Value Localization in LLMs
result.summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with multiple, potentially conflicting human values remains challenging, as existing multi-objective alignment methods often require costly fine-tuning and provide limited insight into the internal mechanisms underlying value-related behaviors. In this work, we investigate multi-value alignment from a mechanistic interpretability perspective by identifying value-sensitive attention heads (value heads) in LLMs. Using a probing-based value localization framework, we discover sparse sets of attention heads associated with diverse dimensions, spanning both human values (e.g., harmlessness, honesty) and stylistic preferences (e.g., coherence, complexity). Analyses across multiple LLM families reveal functional specialization and structured interactions among value heads, including conflicts between certain values. Targeted head ablations further induce substantial, value-specific behavioral changes, providing causal evidence of their functional importance. Building on these findings, we propose an inference-time activation steering strategy that enables controllable alignment with individual values or combinations of values without updating the underlying model parameters, supported by theoretical analysis. Experiments across multiple value alignment benchmarks demonstrate effective single- and multi-value control while largely preserving non-target model performance. Our findings connect mechanistic interpretability with flexible multi-value alignment, offering a foundation for more interpretable and pluralistic LLM behavior. The code is available at https://github.com/sihuo-design/ValueHeads.

AI.brief_summary: 该文从机制可解释性出发，用基于探针的价值定位框架在 LLM 中找出稀疏的「价值注意力头」，通过头消融给出因果证据，并提出推理期激活引导以在不更新参数的情况下控制单一或组合价值。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「探针定位—注意力头消融—推理期激活引导」流程可供核查是否用于定位并因果干预 LVR 中承载视觉证据或推理状态的内部组件；但研究对象是价值对齐而非多模态推理，迁移性待验证。
